MinTemperatureComment: Minimum outside temperature (Celsius) required if CheckTemperature is true.
CheckRainComment: If true, mod will check if its raining.
CheckWindComment: If true, mod will check wind speed.
CheckTemperatureComment: If true, mod will check if the temperature is above MinTemperature.
ShowRedNotificationComment: Displays warning messages for failed attempts and reason.
EnableDebugLoggingComment: If true, debug logs will be enabled for VanillaFirestarterHandler.
